reviews.evidence: The patch moves the current mat-mdc-slider theme onto MDC slider token maps, including active-track height 6px and handle size 20px. It does not touch legacy-slider. The owned slider styles do not reference mdc-slider tokens, and they were not changed.

The patch skips _onChange while typing when requireSelection is set, and the MDC spec then expects the model to stay at the previous object instead of the typed string Cali. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-trigger-base.ts already has that same guard and comment. No source was changed.

The patch deletes upstream _theming.scss and the .import.scss and -legacy-index.scss shims, and says @import is no longer supported. This package still has 29 .import.scss files and the legacy-index forwards, including legacy-button and legacy-slider. None of those files were deleted.

The patch makes MatChipOption._handlePrimaryActionInteraction call focus() before toggleSelected, to clear a Safari focus leftover. The owned chips have no MatChipOption and no _handlePrimaryActionInteraction, and that method was not added.

The patch keeps the MDC slider thumb active on iOS only when the pointer is on the thumb, and it skips pointer focus and animation on iOS. The owned slider has no MatSliderThumb and sets _isActive from the focus origin. That iOS path was not added.

The patch moves MDC checkbox unthemable tokens from checkbox.scss into a new checkbox-base mixin called by checkbox-theme. The owned forward lists checkbox-theme, color, typography, and density, and styles/checkbox/_checkbox-theme.scss has no base mixin. That mixin was not added.

The patch deletes the MDC text-field theme-variable refresh and moves mat-mdc-form-field colors onto tokens. styles/form-field/_form-field-theme.scss still calls private-text-field-refresh-theme-variables, and the refresh file is still present. Those styles were not rewritten.

The patch adds progress-bar-base and emits MDC linear-progress unthemable tokens from progress-bar-theme. The owned forward lists progress-bar-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/progress-bar/_progress-bar-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds tooltip-base and emits MDC plain-tooltip unthemable tokens from tooltip-theme. The owned forward lists tooltip-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/tooltip/_tooltip-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds progress-spinner-base and emits MDC circular-progress unthemable tokens from progress-spinner-theme. The owned forward lists progress-spinner-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/progress-spinner/_progress-spinner-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds card-base and emits MDC elevated and outlined card unthemable tokens from card-theme. The owned forward lists card-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/card/_card-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC card tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-card. styles/card/_card-theme.scss still nests the color, typography, and density token values under .mat-mdc-card. That selector was not changed.

The patch adds fab-base and emits MDC fab and extended-fab unthemable tokens from fab-theme. The owned forward lists fab-color, typography, density, and theme. styles/button has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC tooltip tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-tooltip. styles/tooltip/_tooltip-theme.scss still nests the color, typography, and density token values under .mat-mdc-tooltip. That selector was not changed.

The patch adds slider-base and emits MDC slider unthemable tokens from slider-theme. The owned forward lists slider-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/slider/_slider-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch replaces a single dialog title id with a queue so aria-labelledby updates when a title is destroyed. MatLegacyDialogTitle already pushes its id onto _ariaLabelledByQueue and splices it out in ngOnDestroy, and the container already binds aria-labelledby to the first queued id. No source was changed.

The patch deletes 702 files, including the legacy component trees, and stops forwarding their Sass from _index.scss. This package still has all 22 legacy directories, from autocomplete through tooltip, and the facade still forwards them. None of those directories were deleted.

The patch inlines CDK_ROW_TEMPLATE and CDK_TABLE_TEMPLATE on the MDC table so local compilation can see the template. The owned legacy rows still use CDK_ROW_TEMPLATE with class mat-header-row. The owned table template is a separate inline template with thead and tbody. Those templates were not rewritten.

The patch deletes the shared _Mat*Base classes after the legacy components were removed, and folds that behavior into the current Mat* classes. This package still exports those bases, including _MatAutocompleteBase, _MatDialogBase, _MatSelectBase, _MatCheckboxBase, and _MatTooltipBase. None of those classes were removed.

The patch adds snack-bar-base and emits MDC snack-bar unthemable tokens from snack-bar-theme. The owned forward lists snack-bar-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/snack-bar/_snack-bar-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch adds list-base and emits MDC list unthemable tokens from list-theme. The owned forward lists list-theme, color, typography, and density. styles/list/_list-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch sets text-align left, and right under dir=rtl, on the MDC progress bar so a parent text-align does not shift it. This package has no MDC progress-bar.scss. The owned legacy rule is .mat-progress-bar, which has display block and no text-align. That rule was not changed.
The patch corrects the comment spelling autcomplete to autocomplete on requireSelection. legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-base.ts already uses the corrected spelling. No source was changed.

The patch sets cursor pointer on .mat-mdc-form-field-type-mat-select .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper. This package has no such selector. The owned legacy select sets cursor pointer on .mat-select-trigger. That rule was not changed.

The patch moves the hover opacity from .mat-mdc-form-field:hover to .mat-mdc-text-field-wrapper:hover so the subscript does not show the hover state. styles/form-field/_form-field-focus-overlay.scss line 29 still uses .mat-mdc-form-field:hover. That selector was not changed.

The patch calls markForCheck on CdkTable when the no-data row is shown or hidden. MatLegacyTable extends CdkTable and does not reimplement that toggle. MatLegacyNoDataRow only sets the mat-no-data-row class. The CDK method was not copied into this package.

The patch adds dialog-base and emits MDC dialog unthemable tokens from dialog-theme. The owned forward lists dialog-theme, color, typography, density, and dialog-legacy-padding. styles/dialog/_dialog-theme.scss has no base mixin, and that mixin was not added.

The patch emits MDC circular-progress color tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-progress-spinner. styles/progress-spinner/_progress-spinner-theme.scss still nests those tokens under .mat-mdc-progress-spinner, including the accent and warn rules. That selector was not changed.

The patch widens the MDC range thumb input at min and max by changing the ripple padding inside MatSliderRangeThumb. This package has no MatSliderRangeThumb and no slider-input. The owned legacy slider was not changed.

The patch updates MatSliderThumb so an iOS pointer on the thumb sets the active width and slider dimensions without also focusing the input. This package has no MatSliderThumb. The owned legacy slider was not changed.

The patch adds cdkConnectedOverlayDisposeOnNavigation on CdkConnectedOverlay and passes it into the overlay config. This package does not define that directive. The owned select template binds other cdkConnectedOverlay inputs and does not set disposeOnNavigation. That binding was not added.

The patch emits MDC snack-bar color and typography tokens with current-selector-or-root instead of under .mat-mdc-snack-bar-container. styles/snack-bar/_snack-bar-theme.scss still nests both mixins under .mat-mdc-snack-bar-container. That selector was not changed.

The patch reads card, core, form-field, option, optgroup, progress-bar, pseudo-checkbox, and ripple themes through inspection.get-theme-color and theme-has. The owned copies of those themes still call theming.get-color-config. The inspection API was not added.

The patch sets word-break normal on .mdc-slider__value-indicator so a parent word-break does not change the MDC value indicator. This package has no MDC slider.scss. The owned legacy thumb label has no word-break rule, and none was added.
The patch only changes a comment on InteractivityChecker, from whether is is focusable to whether it is focusable. This package does not define that class. No source was changed.

The patch replaces mixinDisabled and mixinDisableRipple on MatMenuItem with booleanAttribute inputs. MatLegacyMenuItem still extends the peer menu item and still declares inputs disabled and disableRipple. The owned mixin helpers under legacy-menu/internal/common-behaviors remain.

The patch reads the remaining component themes through the inspection API and removes legacy-typography-hierarchy. The owned themes still call theming.get-color-config. The facade still forwards legacy-typography-hierarchy, and that mixin was not removed.
The patch sets aria-hidden on an inactive MDC tab panel. legacy-tabs/tab-group.html binds aria-labelledby on mat-tab-body and does not bind aria-hidden from selectedIndex. That binding was not added.

The patch marks an MDC dialog component host with mat-mdc-dialog-component-host and display contents so the surface flex layout reaches the title and actions. This package has no such class. MatLegacyDialogContainer does not override attachComponentPortal. That class was not added.

limitations: The other 1001 behavior-semantic SHAs were not read.
